entries.author: teacher
entries.content: Root cause: in `pandas/io/json/_json.py`, `Parser._convert_axes` always rebuilt the axis via `Index(new_ser, ...)`, so a `RangeIndex` produced by the DataFrame constructor was coerced to a plain `Index` even when the axis conversion was a no-op. Fix: after building `new_axis`, if the original axis is a `RangeIndex` and the converted axis equals it, keep the original `RangeIndex` (skip `setattr`). This restores `RangeIndex` for `read_json(..., lines=True)` (including `nrows` paths) while preserving date/string index conversion behavior, verified with the full io/json test suite (only pre-existing network/pyarrow failures remain).
